system.description:
Make an Interface Roll (20) over the
body of a creature who died within the
current scene.
The body must still be mostly
recoverable, or there must be an intact
brain, neural core, cybernetic backup,
or vital implant you can work from.
On a success, restore the creature to
life using emergency surgery, synthetic
organs, neural rebooting, clone tissue,
or cybernetic replacement.
The restored creature clears all marked
HP, then marks 3 Stress. They return
alive, conscious, and stable, but
physically and psychologically shaken.
Until their next long rest, they are
temporarily Vulnerable and can’t
benefit from Lazarus Procedure again.
Then roll a d6. On a result of 5 or lower,
place this card in your vault
permanently.
